title: Five stray run registrations from pre-fix cli test runs remain in the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry, pointing at deleted temp dirs
body: This tick stops NEW strays but cannot clean machine state outside the repo: the operator's registry still holds r-status.json, r-1.json, r-sigterm.json, epic-rmod.json and epic-run.json, each pointing at a temp checkout that no longer exists, and 9oo's cross-checkout refusal reads a registration back on every claim of those run ids. A deleted dir probes not_running so the refusal does not fire today, but the strays are still enumerable surface noise for every listing that reads the machine's registrations. Removing them is an operator-machine action (rm of five files in ~/.ticfac/registry), not a repo change, so it is reported here rather than done.
triaged_by: claude (operator-delegated): cleaned up by hand - removed the 5 stale ~/.ticfac/registry entries pointing at deleted test temp dirs
